Shared essentials, regional sections, footwear, packing mistakes, working checklist and FAQ. It shows how climate changes the list but covers a much wider trip than the proposed post.

supplemental_dual_climate_reference.use: Confirmed that a shared base and removable layers answer the two-climate packing intent; not used as a model for Cottonworld's wording or section order.

editorial_benchmark: Target roughly 1,200-1,600 useful words. Start with a real short-trip packing tension, move from route and forecast to a shared clothing base, then a conditional cooler layer, clean-clothes planning and a final bag check. Keep Cottonworld's calm Indian everyday voice. No competitor wording, list or section structure was copied.
limitations: Extracted word counts are approximate and may include page furniture; G Adventures required a separate web text fetch. Search demand and fixed rankings were not verified.
